en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Fazal Abu Al Abbas Al Baqbaaq, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The mother is not barred from the third except (if there are) two brothers, or four sisters of the father and mother, or of the father’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ‘Abd Allah ibn Bukayr from Fadl abu al-‘Abbas al-Baqbaq who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A mother is not barred from receiving one-third except because of two brothers or four sisters from both parents.”’
